agentUtterance.text:
If you brought a certified pre-owned phone, it's subject to the Bell limited warranty, valid for 12 months from the purchase date. If your phone is not working due to a manufacturer issue that occurs within 12 months of your purchase, we will replace the phone with a comparable unit.
Did you purchase your device within the last 12 months?
Have you enrolled in our smart care program?

When submitting a request online or calling the Smart Phone Care Center, your request will be processed by Asurion, the administrator of the Smartphone Care program. I can send you a link to submit your request. Is that alright?

actionParameters.utterance: My Preloved phone button is not working
